definition_quote.value: Practice of medicine means: (A) Holding out oneself to the public within this state as being able to diagnose, treat, prescribe for, palliate, or prevent any human disease, ailment, injury, deformity, or physical or mental condition, whether by the use of drugs, surgery, manipulation, electricity, or any physical, mechanical, or other means whatsoever; (B) Suggesting, recommending, prescribing, or administering any form of treatment, operation, or healing for the intended palliation, relief, or cure of any physical or mental disease, ailment, injury, condition, or defect of any person with the intention of receiving, either directly or indirectly, any fee, gift, or compensation whatsoever; (C) Maintaining an office or other place to meet persons for the purpose of examining or treating persons afflicted with disease, injury, or defect of body or mind; (D) Using the title 'M.D.', 'M.B.', 'D.O.', 'physician', 'surgeon', or any other word or abbreviation to indicate or induce others to believe that one is engaged in the diagnosis or treatment of persons afflicted with disease, injury, or defect of body or mind; (E) Performing any kind of surgical operation upon a human being; or (F) Delegating certain medical practices to other personnel under rules adopted by the board.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of medicine" means: (A) Holding out oneself to the public within this state as being able to diagnose, treat, prescribe for, palliate, or prevent any human disease, ailment, injury, deformity, or physical or mental condition, whether by the use of drugs, surgery, manipulation, electricity, or any physical, mechanical, or other means whatsoever

methods_authorized.quote: diagnose, treat, prescribe for, palliate, or prevent any human disease, ailment, injury, deformity, or physical or mental condition, whether by the use of drugs, surgery, manipulation, electricity, or any physical, mechanical, or other means whatsoever

drug_authority.value: Licensed physicians may prescribe, administer, and dispense legend drugs and controlled substances (with board approval for dispensing outside office); Schedule II narcotic prescribing is subject to board-promulgated limits.
drug_authority.quote: A physician licensed under the Arkansas Medical Practices Act ... shall not dispense legend drugs without prior approval by the Arkansas State Medical Board after application to the board and on the showing of need.

license_status_types.quote: The Arkansas State Medical Board may issue an academic license to practice medicine ... The Arkansas State Medical Board may issue a temporary license ... the physician is eligible for an active, unrestricted license to practice medicine in the state.

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical school graduates must have the school approved by the Arkansas State Medical Board, and must have: (1) served 3 years as intern/resident/fellow in an accredited US postgraduate medical education program; OR (2) served 3 years in a postgraduate program outside US, completed all steps of USMLE, obtained ECFMG certification, and completed 1 year ACGME fellowship or received ABMS certification; OR (3) completed 1 year as intern/resident in accredited US postgraduate program and be currently enrolled in accredited postgraduate program in Arkansas.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: A foreign medical school whose entrance requirements and course of instruction have been approved by the Arkansas State Medical Board. He or she must also have: Served three (3) years as an intern, resident, or fellow, or a combination thereof, in an accredited postgraduate medical education program in the United States

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: Served three (3) years as an intern, resident, or fellow, or a combination thereof, in an accredited postgraduate medical education program in the United States

pain_management_education_required.quote: At any level of sanction, the board may require continuing medical education hours in proper prescribing habits.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: The board is authorized to promulgate rules limiting the amount of Schedule II narcotics that may be prescribed and dispensed by licensees.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: Promulgate rules limiting the amount of Schedule II narcotics that may be prescribed and dispensed by licensees of the board.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Healthcare services provided by telemedicine, including a prescription through telemedicine, shall be held to the same standard of care as healthcare services provided in person. A professional relationship must exist before providing telemedicine services. A healthcare professional must be fully licensed in Arkansas. Telemedicine does not include audio-only technology to renew a written certification previously issued to the same patient.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: Healthcare services provided by telemedicine, including without limitation a prescription through telemedicine, shall be held to the same standard of care as healthcare services provided in person.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: A healthcare professional who is treating patients in Arkansas through telemedicine shall be fully licensed or certified to practice in Arkansas and is subject to the rules of the appropriate state licensing or certification board.

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: Works under a physician-drafted protocol approved by the Arkansas State Medical Board, which describes how the graduate registered physician and the physician will work together and practice guidelines required by the supervising physician

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: A supervising physician may delegate prescriptive authority to a graduate registered physician to include Schedules III-V controlled substances, all legend drugs, and all nonschedule prescription medications and medical devices. Prescriptive authority shall not exceed the authority of the supervising physician.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: A physician who is supervising a graduate registered physician may delegate prescriptive authority to a graduate registered physician to include prescribing, ordering, and administering Schedules III-V controlled substances ... all legend drugs, and all nonschedule prescription medications and medical devices.

max_physician_assistants_per_supervising.quote: Limit supervision to no more than two (2) graduate registered physicians per supervising physician.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The Arkansas Medical Society, Inc. shall have the authority to establish a physicians' health committee ... to undertake the functions and responsibilities to carry out the purposes of this subchapter

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: If the Arkansas State Medical Board has reason to believe that a physician is impaired ... either board may cause an evaluation of the physician or dentist to be conducted by the appropriate committee for the purpose of determining if there is an impairment.

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: In cases of emergency and to prevent hardship, the Director of the Arkansas State Medical Board may issue a temporary permit to practice medicine upon payment of the fee required for applicants after satisfying himself or herself that the applicant has all the qualifications and meets all the requirements
